name: tendsto_apply_add_mul_sq_div_sub
statement: ℝ → ℝ} {x a c d : ℝ} {l : Filter ℝ} (hl : l ≤ 𝓝[≠] x) (hf : Tendsto (fun y => (f y - d) / (y - x)) l (𝓝 a)) (h' : Tendsto (fun y => y + c * (y - x) ^ 2) l l) : Tendsto (fun y => (f (y + c * (y - x) ^ 2) - d) / (y - x)) l (𝓝 a)

have_tree.type: ∀ᶠ y in l, y + c * (y - x) ^ 2 ≠ x
have_tree.body: by apply Tendsto.mono_right h' hl self_mem_nhdsWithin
